messages:
Mia Chen: Quick QA note: on iPhone SE the left console sidebar icons are too close together, several accidental taps. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/attachments/side-touch.png
Samir Patel: thanks. what viewport? :eyes:
Mia Chen: 320x568, hit area feels ~28-32px visually.
Priya Nair: that's under Apple's 44pt recommendation. we should guarantee a 44px tappable area even if icon art is small.
Kai Gomez: easy fix: invisible padding around the icon so layout stays identical but touch target grows. e.g.
```
.sidebar-icon { padding: 8px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-width:44px; min-height:44px; }
```
Priya Nair: also add accessible name: aria-label="Open sidebar: Model settings" for VO.
Mia Chen: another problem: on that viewport the table rows wrap and the actions menu gets pushed offscreen to the right. QA couldn't find the actions three-dots.
Kai Gomez: for <=360px my suggestion: stack primary and secondary columns into two lines per row and pin the actions column as the left-most or always-visible cell. avoid horizontal scroll where possible.
Samir Patel: alternatives discussed: native horizontal scroll, stacked two-line rows, or hide low-priority cols behind an expand chevron. each has tradeoffs (discoverability vs vertical space).
Mia Chen: my preference: stack on very small screens, and keep actions pinned so users always see it.
Priya Nair: if we implement an expand-to-show pattern make sure to move focus into the expanded content and expose aria-expanded on the control. add keyboard/VO flows in the checklist.
Design-Bot: prototype uploaded: https://figma.redwood.test/file/console/mobile-row-stack. added accessibility checklist (44px targets, labels, focus management).
Samir Patel: small copy nit: the current control reads "Open in drawer" which is awkward on phones. suggest "Expand" or "More". SR label: "Expand row details".
Mia Chen: also thinking about sidebar breakpoint: currently collapse at 720px. proposal: collapse for phones at <=640px and keep tablets with sidebar. plus, on phones convert the active-model view into a bottom sheet rather than an off-canvas sidebar for better discoverability.
Kai Gomez: bottom-sheet approach makes sense for workflows that need a lot of vertical space (model settings). implementation note: ensure keyboard avoids overlapping pinned actions.
Samir Patel: action items: Samir - prototype the touch-target CSS and demo; Kai - implement stacked-row pattern for <=360px and pin actions; Priya - write aria/focus guidance; Mia - update copy to "Expand" and coordinate QA retest.
Mia Chen: can we get a prototype by end of sprint (Fri)? :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: I'll push a basic demo by Friday EOD.
Deploy-Bot: Branch `feat/mobile-touch-targets` created by samir, CI queued.
Mia Chen: tagging @QA for follow-up once demo is live. Thanks everyone!
